# 1 Introduction
# 1 引言
1. Bertrand and Schoar (2003) document the presence of managerial “fixed effects”, i.e. systematic performance differentials that can be attributed to individual managers. Custódio et al. (2013) discuss the rising importance of “generalist” CEOs (i.e. executives that gained experience in a variety of industries prior to appointment vs. specialized managers). Frydman (2019) documents, in addition to the relevance of generalist experience, the sustained increase in CEOs with business degrees. Custódio and Metzger (2013) document the importance of CEOs' industry specific knowledge in the context of M\&A activities, while Benmelech and Frydman (2015) focus on CEOs with military experience. Bandiera et al. (2020) study the behavior of CEOs and its relationship with firm performance. Kaplan et al. (2012) study the characteristics and psychological traits of candidate and hired executives in the context of a sample of companies involved in buyout and venture capital transactions. Kaplan and Sorensen (2021) use the same psychological assessments for a broader sample of CEO candidates.
1. Bertrand 和 Schoar（2003）记录了管理者“固定效应”的存在，即可归因于个体管理者的系统性绩效差异。Custódio 等（2013）讨论了“通才型”CEO（即在获聘前曾在多个行业积累经验的高管，相对于专业化管理者）日益重要的地位。Frydman（2019）除通才经验的相关性外，还记录了拥有商科背景的 CEO 持续增加。Custódio 和 Metzger（2013）记录了 CEO 的行业专属知识在并购活动情境中的重要性，而 Benmelech 和 Frydman（2015）则关注具有军事经验的 CEO。Bandiera 等（2020）研究 CEO 的行为及其与企业绩效的关系。Kaplan 等（2012）在一组涉及收购和风险投资交易的公司样本中，研究候选人和受聘高管的特征与心理特质。Kaplan 和 Sorensen（2021）对更广泛的 CEO 候选人样本使用了相同的心理评估。
5. Bandiera et al. (2015) also study the matching between middle managers, firms and incentives in the context of the Italian labor market, but they do not directly observe the demand for managerial skills.
5. Bandiera 等（2015）也在意大利劳动力市场情境中研究了中层管理者、企业与激励之间的匹配，但他们并未直接观察管理技能的需求。
The growth of the Social Skills cluster is especially interesting, in our view, in that its growing relevance mirrors broader trends in the general labor market as documented in Deming (2017). Additionally, this skill is the most likely to be included in CEO job descriptions relative to other C-suite positions. We use a stylized model in the spirit of Garicano (2000) to further study the relationship between the demand for social skills and firms' characteristics. In this framework, vertical communication between the workforce and the C-suite raises productivity, but communication is costly. Whereas Garicano (2000) conceives of this cost as arising due to technological reasons, we view them as also depending on managerial social skills. $^{6}$ In the model, greater social skills in the C-suite become more important when the volume of problems needed to be solved rises, and when the interaction between workers and C-suite becomes more important for production. These are situations which increase the demand for and the value of executive time, which is limited, and social skills allow a relaxation of managerial time constraints.
在我们看来，社交技能集群的增长尤其有趣，因为其日益上升的重要性反映了 Deming（2017）所记录的更广泛劳动力市场趋势。此外，相对于其他高管职位，这一技能最有可能出现在 CEO 职位描述中。我们采用一个秉承 Garicano（2000）精神的程式化模型，进一步研究社交技能需求与企业特征之间的关系。在该框架中，员工队伍与高管层之间的纵向沟通会提高生产率，但沟通是有成本的。Garicano（2000）认为这种成本源于技术原因，而我们则认为它也取决于管理者的社交技能。$^{6}$ 在模型中，当需要解决的问题数量上升、且员工与高管层之间的互动对生产变得更加重要时，高管层中更强的社交技能就变得更加重要。这些情形提高了对高管时间的需求及其价值，而高管时间是有限的，社交技能则能够放松管理者时间约束。
6. The idea that social skills facilitate problem exchange is also present in Deming (2017) who models the horizontal exchange of problems within a team of workers rather than the vertical exchange of problems within an organizational hierarchy.
6. 社交技能促进问题交换的思想也出现在 Deming（2017）中，但他建模的是工人团队内部问题的横向交换，而非组织层级内部问题的纵向交换。
**Related Literature** This paper relates to several literatures. As mentioned above, Deming (2017) is a seminal contribution that shows a growing importance of social skills in the labor market. The analysis in Deming (2017) shows that occupations that are more intensive in social skills have a growing share in the overall labor market. We instead show that

Finally, our paper makes a methodological contribution: the overall measurement strategy is generic and can be applied in other situations in which a researcher wishes to measure skill content from job descriptions. Dictionary methods in which researchers use keyword counts to measure content have traditionally dominated the analysis of text in economics and finance (e.g. Baker et al. 2016) and have also been used to measure the skill content of job descriptions (e.g. Deming and Kahn 2018). Our method is more automated, retains interpretability, and draws on semantic relationships derived from the entire HBR vocabulary to measure content rather than a small number of search terms. We make publicly available our HBR embedding model for researchers who wish to measure skill content in other settings, or who require language similarity comparisons in business contexts more generally. $^{9}$
最后，本文作出了方法论贡献：整体测量策略具有通用性，可应用于研究者希望从职位描述中衡量技能内容的其他情形。研究者以关键词计数衡量内容的词典法，传统上主导了经济学和金融学中的文本分析（例如 Baker 等 2016），也被用于衡量职位描述中的技能内容（例如 Deming 和 Kahn 2018）。我们的方法自动化程度更高，保留了可解释性，并利用从整个 HBR 词汇表得出的语义关系来衡量内容，而非依赖少量检索词。我们公开提供 HBR 嵌入模型，供希望在其他情境中衡量技能内容、或需要在更一般的商业语境中进行语言相似性比较的研究者使用。$^{9}$

# 5 社交技能需求
One of the novel stylized facts emerging from the classification of the job descriptions is the importance of Social skills in executive searches, especially in CEO job descriptions, and its large increase over time relative to all other clusters. In common with Deming (2017), we interpret the Social cluster as capturing the ability to read and react to others based on tacit knowledge. # 5.1 Modeling the Demand for Social Skills in the C-suite
# 5.1 高管层社交技能需求的建模
A seminal paper establishing a connection between social skills and communication frictions is Deming (2017). The model studies the role of workers' social skills in a team production setting, where individuals with similar hierarchical status can trade tasks with each other
Deming (2017) 是将社交技能与沟通摩擦联系起来的开创性论文。该模型研究了工人在团队生产环境中的社交技能的作用，在这一环境中，层级地位相近的个体可以彼此交换任务
Our setting differs from Deming (2017) in one important respect, however. While co-production with other hierarchical peers is surely part of what C-suite managers do, their job typically consists of other coordination or advisory activities that require interactions with lower-ranked employees. $^{26}$ To tailor our analysis to C-suite settings, we thus need to depart from the Deming (2017) model to allow for team communication flows that are primarily vertical, i.e. involve individuals with different hierarchical status and specifically workers and managers. We do so through a model examining the role of social skills within a simple setup in which, as in Garicano (2000), production hinges on interactions between workers and a manager to solve problems.
然而，我们的设定在一个重要方面与 Deming (2017) 不同。虽然与其他同级同僚的共同生产确实是高管层经理工作的一部分，但他们的工作通常还包括其他协调或咨询活动，这些活动需要与层级较低的员工互动。$^{26}$ 为使分析契合高管层的情形，我们需要偏离 Deming (2017) 的模型，允许以纵向为主的团队沟通流，即涉及层级地位不同的个体、特别是工人与经理的沟通流。为此，我们构建了一个模型，在与 Garicano (2000) 相同的简单设定中考察社交技能的作用，其中生产取决于工人与一名经理之间为解决问题而进行的互动。
# 5.1.1 Model setup
# 5.1.1 模型设定
In practice, communication frictions can limit organizations from achieving this. In Garicano (2000) communication frictions arise due to managerial time constraints combined with a technological cost of communicating between levels of the organizational hierarchy. In our setting, we maintain a C-suite time constraint but instead conceive of communication costs as arising from the (lack of) social skills of managers. The key assumption is that executives with good social skills are able to spend less time communicating with workers to understand the problems that must be solved. This idea is explored by Deming (2017) in the context of collaborative production in the labor force, but rarely in the context of hierarchical manager-worker interactions. $^{28}$ The time cost of communicating a unit mass of problems is c and the total time available for the C-suite to engage in communication is T. The efficient output level $y^{E}$ is therefore only attainable when $1 \leq \frac{T}{c}$ , where 1 is the demand for managerial time (i.e. the unit mass of problems for which communication is valuable) and $\frac{T}{c}$ is the effective supply of time. For the remainder of the analysis, we focus on a situation in which this condition fails so that the C-suite lacks the social skills to fully realize the gains from interaction.
在实践中，沟通摩擦可能使组织无法实现这一目标。在 Garicano (2000) 中，沟通摩擦源于管理者时间约束与组织层级之间沟通的技术成本的共同作用。在我们的设定中，我们保留了高管层的时间约束，但将沟通成本视为源于管理者社交技能的（缺乏）。关键假设是，社交技能良好的高管能够花更少的时间与工人沟通，以理解必须解决的问题。Deming (2017) 在劳动力协同生产的背景下探讨了这一思想，但很少在层级式经理—工人互动的背景下加以探讨。$^{28}$ 沟通单位测度的问题的时间成本为 c，高管层可用于沟通的总时间为 T。因此，只有当 $1 \leq \frac{T}{c}$ 时，才能达到有效产出水平 $y^{E}$，其中 1 是对管理者时间的需求（即沟通有价值的单位测度的问题），而 $\frac{T}{c}$ 是时间的有效供给。在分析的其余部分，我们关注这一条件不成立的情形，即高管层缺乏社交技能以充分实现互动带来的收益。
26. Using detailed time diaries on a sample of 1,114 CEOs, Bandiera et al. (2020) show that executives spend on average 70% of their time in interactive activities such as meetings and calls, of which only a fraction involves exclusively other C-suite managers.
26. Bandiera 等（2020）利用 1,114 位 CEO 样本的详细时间日志表明，高管平均将 70% 的时间用于会议和通话等互动性活动，其中只有一小部分仅涉及其他高管。
